name: odd_resonant_reindex325
math: For positive odd q, the reciprocal Mobius sum through M on odd multiples of q equals the sum over odd multiplier indices through the integer quotient of M by q of mu of q n divided by q n.

name: odd_resonant_mobius_bound325
math: For every positive q, the reciprocal Mobius sum through M restricted to odd multiples of q has absolute value at most inverse q. Even q gives an empty sum.
